NEOW.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.0-1.c: We can't live on like this! We have no food, no housing, no guidance! Who is responsible for the state of the Spire!?
NEOW.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.2-1.c: I'm... doing my best. I promise. Things will change. They must...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKY: Are you the Architect? [blue]Mazaleth[/blue]'s people need help! They suffer down in the docks--
Their misery is self-inflicted. I have better things to do with my time.
What!? Can't you see they need help!? You cannot possibly imagine a nobler cause!
If it is nobility you seek, Nonupeipe is a few floors down. Now begone.
Architect, we are in need, if you could just assist us...!
You again? Haven't I made it clear this isn't [red]my[/red] problem?
Architect! You betray your duty to the people of the Spire!
I have no such duty. Leave, now.
[sine]Little byrdling[/sine], what lovely feathers you bear! Why do you fear them so?
I never asked for them! I meant to save my people, not join them in madness!

The path to a better you isn't always charted, my dear.
May my gift help you connect with your inner self!
Welcome back, little byrdling. Might you regale us with a song today before you depart? A gift for a gift!
[sine]Little byrdling[/sine]! My favorite of Neow's puppets. What can I offer you this time...
Could you... not call me that anymore? Please? I'm not a byrd. And I don't want to be one.
And yet it seems to make you don a smile every time.

I-I-- That's not--
[i][font_size=22]The Valkyrie looks away, self-conscious.[/font_size][/i]
Now, now, no need to make a face. Take one of these and dry your tears, little byrdling.
DARV.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.0-0.a: A new face! Bit young t'be doin' what you're doin', aintcha?
DARV.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.0-1.c: What is this place? Are you a merchant?
DARV.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.0-2.a: In a way! But these coins you've been collectin' will be no good here! How about you take somethin' now and we discuss payment later?
DARV.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-0.a: Ah, you're back! Now, I'm lookin' for trinkets. You got anythin' that could make our partnership worth my while?
DARV.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-1.c:
[i][font_size=22]The Valkyrie pulls out a worn-looking dagger.[/font_size][/i]
Will this do?
DARV.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-2.a: Ah, you're one of those people... Tell you what, I already owe you lot a favor. Let's say I keep helpin' you and that makes us even!
Wouldn't have half of my collection without the Flock. Take somethin', it might as well be yours anyway!
[i][font_size=22]Vakuu lets out an amused chuckle.[/font_size][/i]
If it isn't the hubris of youth, in the flesh!
Countless like you have bargained for more than they could handle.
Sign this contract, and let us see if you will be an exception...
VAKUU.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-0r: You remind me of my favorite puppet. Too bad Neow found you first...
That 'Angel' form of yours... Isn't it more like a Harpy?
I am not here to listen to your nonsensical babbling, [i]demon[/i].
YOU WIELD A MIGHTY WEAPON!! HAVE ANOTHER!!
TANX.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-0.a: WHY HAVE A SHIELD WHEN YOU CAN USE ANOTHER WEAPON!!
TANX.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-1.c: [i][font_size=22]The Valkyrie considers this sage wisdom for a moment.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.2-1.c: [i][font_size=22]The Valkyrie recklessly charges at the beast and the two clash.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.2-2.a: YESSSS!!! YOU UNDERSTAND PERFECTLY!!! HAVE ALL OF THE WEAPONS!!!
[thinky_dots]I dreamt I was flying... Do you do, too...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-0.a: [thinky_dots]Why do you believe murder will improve things...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-1.c: Why would the death of a tyrant not?
PAEL.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.1-2.a: [thinky_dots]Father wishes you no harm... You assume so much...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.2-1.c: No. I feel like if I ever stop moving, I will never get back up again.
OROBAS.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.0-2: More than half-byrd!! More byrd every second!!!
OROBAS.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.2-1: I must find a way to make the Spire worth living in again.
OROBAS.talk.THEVALKYRIE-THE_VALKYRIE.2-2: Architect help? Can make big things!! Talking with him! Okay!?
Who might be visiting me this time?
I am a... fighter. ...formerly... of the Flock.
Welcome in. Let me teach you how [jitter][b]family[/b][/jitter] can be your strength.
Let's take that [jitter][b]hotheadedness[/b][/jitter] of yours and give it direction.
Do you really think you will stay mad at them forever?
I can't forgive them. But that doesn't mean I won't help them.
Good. Home is where the [jitter][b]hearth[/b][/jitter] is.
